history.summary: Built in 2003 by His Holiness Mahavishnu Goswami Maharaj and inaugurated by then Gujarat Chief Minister Narendra Modi and Alfred Brush Ford (Ambarish Das) of Ford Motor Company, USA. The Hare Krishna temple-cum-ashram is dedicated to Sri Sri Radha Neelmadhav, with shrines to Jagannath-Balabhadra-Subhadra, Rama-Lakshmana-Sita and Prahlad-Narasimha; the complex includes a Gopal Goshala (cowshed), vegetarian restaurant, library and devotional-material shop.

name: ISKCON Temple, Rajkot (Sri Sri Radha Neelmadhav Dham)
town_description: Rajkot is the largest city in Gujarat's Saurashtra region and a former princely state capital; Mahatma Gandhi spent part of his early life here, and it is now a major commercial and industrial hub.

travel.airport: Hirasar Rajkot International Airport (~36 km) is the main airport.
travel.railway: Bhaktinagar station is ~5 km (per Yappe.in); Rajkot Junction is the main station (~8 km).
travel.road: On Kalawad (Kalavad) Road at Mota Mava, opposite Kankot Patiya (Rajkot 360005); reached by city bus or auto.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sources conflict (verify): 5:00 AM-12:30 PM and 4:30-8:30 PM (Thrillophilia) vs 7:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:30-9:00 PM (Airial.travel).
